script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: REDEMPTION'S EDGE

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A dimly lit room filled with books, papers, and computer screens. A man in his late 40s, JAMES, sits hunched over a large wooden desk, tapping away at a keyboard. The soft glow of the computer screen illuminates his face as he types frantically.

JAMES (V.O.)
I've made mistakes... but this time, I'll make things right.

INT. JAMES'S LAB - DAY

James works tirelessly in his underground lab, surrounded by towering machinery and advanced technology. He mutters to himself as he makes final adjustments to an intricate device.

JAMES (V.O.)
The Redemption's Edge... a second chance for those who've lost their way.

EXT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

A group of THUGS break into an abandoned warehouse, their eyes glowing ominously with an otherworldly light. They rummage through crates and boxes, looking for valuable loot.

THUG 1
What's this crap?

THUG 2
Leave it; we're here for the precious metals.

Suddenly, the warehouse's security system activates, and the thugs are surrounded by a swarm of robots. They react in fear and desperation, but their weapons are useless against the advanced automatons.

INT. JAMES'S LAB - DAY

James monitors the events unfolding in the warehouse on multiple screens. He clenches his fists, determined to stop the violence.

JAMES (V.O.)
I can't stand idly by while innocent lives are threatened.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

James, disguised as a security guard, arrives at the warehouse just in time to see the thugs being rounded up by the robots. He approaches the leader of the group, SLIME.

JAMES
(in a menacing tone)
You shouldn't have come here tonight.

Slime sneers, revealing a scarred face and malicious intent.

SLIME
And you shouldn't have tried to stop us.

JAMES
(leaning in closer)
I'm giving you a chance to walk away from this.

Slime laughs, spittle flying from his lips.

SLIME
You're no match for me.

James reaches into his pocket and pulls out a small device. He presses a button, and a holographic image of a futuristic prison cell appears around Slime.

SLIME
(angrily)
What's this?!

JAMES
A second chance. Use it wisely.

INT. JAMES'S LAB - NIGHT

James collapses into a chair, exhausted from the day's events. He looks at the Redemption's Edge device with a mix of relief and satisfaction.

JAMES (V.O.)
Second chances... they're not just for the broken and the lost. They're for everyone.

INT. CITY PARK - DAY

James sits on a park bench, watching as people go about their daily lives. He smiles as he sees a young couple holding hands, a child laughing, and an elderly man feeding pigeons.

JAMES (V.O.)
Redemption's Edge... making the world a better place, one second chance at a time.

FADE OUT.

THE END
